map.年金终值计算器 使用指南: Annuity Future Value Calculator User Guide
map.输入每期期末存入金额 PMT、期数 N 与每期利率 i，按复利计算等额年金在期末: Enter the amount PMT deposited at the end of each period, the number of periods N and the periodic rate i, and compute the accumulated future value of an equal annuity at compound interest, for savings and education fund planning.
map.i=0 时退化为 PMT×N。: When i = 0 it degenerates to PMT x N.
map.每期期末等额存入 PMT、共 N 期、每期利率 i 的年金终值。: Future value of an annuity paying PMT at the end of each period for N periods at periodic rate i.
map.攒钱目标：录入每期定投与利率，算期末积累。: Savings goal: enter the regular contribution per period and the rate to compute the accumulation at the end.
map.对比定投：对不同 PMT/期数试算终值。: Compare regular investing: try future values for different PMT and periods.
map.教学演示：演示期初 vs 期末年金（期初多乘 1+i）。: Teaching demonstration: show an annuity-due versus an ordinary annuity (the annuity-due multiplies by 1+i).
map.：示例：每月存 1000、年利率 6%(月 0.5%)、存 12 期，FV≈10: : Example: depositing 1000 per month at an annual rate of 6% (0.5% monthly) for 12 periods, FV about 1000 x ((1.005^12 - 1)/0.005), about 12340 CNY.
map.由两期 GDP 求增长率: Growth rate from two periods of GDP
map.普通年金期末付，期初年金(年金 due)终值多乘(1+i)，略高。结果仅作经济学: An ordinary annuity is paid at the end of the period, while the future value of an annuity-due is multiplied by (1+i) and is slightly higher. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation reference only, do not constitute investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasting and empirical estimation the authoritative statistics and textbooks govern.
map.利率用期利率？: Should the rate be the periodic rate?
map.必须换算到与存款同频的期利率（如月存用月利率），否则错。结果仅作经济学教学与快速: It must be converted to a periodic rate matching the deposit frequency (for example a monthly rate for monthly deposits), otherwise it is wrong. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation reference only, do not constitute investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasting and empirical estimation the authoritative statistics and textbooks govern.
map.年金终值是多笔等额现金流的复利终值之和，本质是序列复利。结果仅作经济学教学与快速: The future value of an annuity is the sum of the compound future values of several equal cash flows, essentially serial compounding. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation reference only, do not constitute investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasting and empirical estimation the authoritative statistics and textbooks govern.
